notes.title: Simulator is Live!
notes.content:
We are happy release exciting new feature, the Simulator, in Sentinels of Freedom. The Simulator, is a robust skirmish mode where you can choose many different aspects of the engagement including:
[list]
[*] Map Location
[*] Objective Type
[*] Heroes
[*] Villains
[*] Additional Enemies
[/list]

There are also additional settings such as:
[list]
[*] Round counts
[*] Random locations
[*] Random Spawns
[*] Quantity of enemies
[*] Rank of Enemies
[/list]

As you progress more, more enemies and maps will unlock. We will also continue to add more to the Simulator as we continue with chapter 2 content.

In Addition to the Simulator, we also added the Data Banks which provides access to Lore, Game Mechanics and Tips and Tricks.  Get up to date on your favorite hero along with with dive into the details of combat!

Feel free to post comments and also please join us on Discord (Underbite Discord) for more direct feedback and interaction with the team.

We will be continuing to look for any ways to improve the experience.

notes.content:

There are also additional settings such as:

Go to properties and select the Beta tab at the end.  Once there, enter the code "[b]UnderbitePreview[/b]" and choose the "open_preview_testing" option.

Feel free to post comments and also please join us on Discord ([url=https://discord.gg/n5Aqsga]Underbite Discord[/url]) for more direct feedback and interaction with the team.

Please note that this is not not the final version of the Simulator.  We will be continuing to look for any ways to improve the experience and squash and bugs.

notes.title: Patch 1.05g - User Feedback Update!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Patch 1.05g[/b][/h1]
Preview update is now live!

We have been working on a fairly large update based on feedback received, addressing many of the top requests. While we plan to continue to enhance the game, we feel this update marks a major step forward. Because of the significance of the update, we are opening up to Preview Testing for those who are interested. Our plan is to release the update live in the next few weeks.

[b]Major Highlights include:[/b]
[list]
[*] Four new Powered Mercs that are very tough enemy types
[*] Summons now do not despawn on engagement change
[*] Ability to rotate character on end turn
[*] Vigilance abilities reset to your chosen facing
[*] Sarge is player controlled!
[*] Dealing double the maximum hp triggers a "Heroic" takedown, recouping 1 AP, and dealing triple gains 2 AP, allowing single attack focused heroes to be more effective in swarms
[*] Fixed a bug causing Legacy's voice to not trigger
[*] Audio re-balance and new settings options
[*] Added Post Processing adjustment in settings
[*] Improved line of sight including smaller units having a correct size in blocking
[*] Initiative order bonuses now offer 1st hero 1 AP and last hero an accuracy bonus
[*] Difficulty settings have been adjusted and corrected
[*] Enemy movement and vigilance triggering on hero moving reduced
[*] Bunker support mode gained a Med Drop
[*] Camera Zoom extended
[*] Character Traits updated to be more balanced with each other
[/list]

[b]Additional Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed red arrows above objective based enemies after incapacitated
[*] Checked levels for inaccessible areas
[*] Fixes to camera bounds
[*] Summoner attacks are duplicated between stances
[*] Reduced visual noise for vigilance circles graphics 
[*] Difficulty settings fixed
[*] Icon updates for summoner
[*] Hit boxes for smaller units adjusted for more accurate LOS
[*] Smoke canister and grenade VFX updates
[/list]

We created a Legacy Build branch option for those who may want to continue with their current character without the changes.  The Beta Branch code is "LiveInThePast"

notes.title: Minor update to Preview Build
notes.content:
We have updated background, personality, and power source stat changes to be balanced to each other instead of relying on purely thematic reasons with some stat changes being clearly better than others. All stat changes are now overall positive for your hero, but some positives still come at a price. [b]Background Traits[/b] are mostly positives, [b]Personality Traits[/b] have both positive and negatives, and [b]Power Sources[/b] have more major stat changes. Most of the stat changes are slight changes to the existing ones, preserving their thematic use, while a few have had some major changes, giving them equal value to others of the same category. This update to the stat changes allows us to more easily understand the balance of the custom hero while bringing more consistent power to the battlefield. Enjoy your newfound inner strength, heroes!

Special thanks to "christopher.rooney" for some great ideas and data gathering.
